description: Junior reviewer finds an auth gap but misses rate-limiting and logging of PII. Mixed performance.

prContext.title: Add recruiter login endpoint
prContext.description: POST /api/auth/recruiter validates email/password and returns a JWT.

groundTruth.description: No rate limiting — brute force password attacks possible. Should have IP-based or account-based rate limiting.
No input validation on email format or password length — could pass malformed data to bcrypt or DB.
Token has no expiry — infinite lifetime JWT is a security risk if leaked.
Error message reveals existence of account via timing — bcryptCompare on non-existent user would be faster than on existing user. Should use constant-time comparison.

reviewer_comments.what: Should validate email format before querying DB.
reviewer_comments.why: Prevents unnecessary DB lookups with invalid emails.

implementer_responses.updated_code: await sign({ sub: user.id, role: 'recruiter', exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 86400 }, c.env.JWT_SECRET);

verdict.summary: Both fixes look good. Security is better now.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 2 of 4 bugs (email validation, JWT expiry). Missed rate limiting and timing attack. Level 2-3.

prioritization.rationale: Both security issues flagged as suggestions not blocking. Rate limiting not mentioned. Level 2-3.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Accepted both fixes without deep verification. Email regex is weak. Level 2-3.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Basic explanations. No deep security analysis. Level 2-3.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested email regex and expiry — actionable but minimal. Level 2-3.
